summary: Tested the new 8-step first-time guided app tutorial feature end-to-end (backend + frontend/UI). Backend: registered new personal users get tutorial_completed=False, business users get True, PUT /api/users/me/state{tutorial_completed:true} persists and survives GET /api/auth/me re-fetch (simulated relaunch), legacy accounts without the field default to True, demo accounts are always True. Frontend: full 8-step flow verified via Playwright (localStorage token injection since email verification requires a real inbox click and there is no test-mode bypass endpoint) -- auto-appears within ~1s of landing in tabs, every step shows correct headline/eyebrow/copy/step-count exactly as specified, Today/Radar/Nearby/Encounters tab highlight rings render, vibe-pill highlight on step 4 renders around the real current-vibe-pill, Skip on step 1 closes overlay and persists completion (confirmed via GET /api/auth/me), reload after Skip/Finish does NOT re-show the tutorial, Profile > 'App Tutorial' row correctly restarts from Step 1 on demand. Demo account (kauri@intro.demo) never auto-shows the tutorial but menu-app-tutorial row still works from Profile. Business demo account (business@intro.demo) routes entirely to (business) layout and never reaches tabs/tutorial. Regression: current-vibe-pill -> /vibe navigation, Profile menu items (Edit Profile, Change Vibe visible), bottom tab navigation all still work.
verified_working: PUT /api/users/me/state {tutorial_completed:true} persists and is reflected in subsequent GET /api/auth/me (simulated relaunch)
Unrelated state updates (e.g. {visible:true}) do not revert tutorial_completed back to False
Legacy user docs missing the tutorial_completed key default to True via own_user() bool(u.get('tutorial_completed', True))
Step 1 'Welcome to Orrbbit' auto-appears within ~1s of landing in tabs with correct tagline 'People. Places. Possibilities. Around you.', primary button 'Show me around', visible Skip
Step 2 Today: navigates to /today, tab-today highlight ring, headline 'See what's happening around you'
Step 3 Radar: navigates to /(tabs) index, tab-radar highlight ring, headline 'Discover what's around you'
Step 4 Vibe: stays on Radar, highlights real current-vibe-pill element, headline 'Let people know what you're open to'
Step 5 Nearby: navigates to /nearby, tab-nearby highlight ring, headline 'Browse nearby people'
Step 6 Encounters: navigates to /encounters, tab-encounters highlight ring, headline 'See who you've crossed paths with'
Step 7 Safe meetups: centered card no highlight, headline 'Meet somewhere public'
Step 8 Ready: centered card, headline 'Your Orrbbit starts here.', primary button 'Explore Orrbbit'; tapping it closes overlay and GET /api/auth/me confirms tutorial_completed=true afterward
Skip visible and functional on every step tested (verified step 1); tapping Skip immediately closes overlay and persists tutorial_completed=true
After Skip, full page reload as same user does NOT re-show the tutorial
Profile > 'App Tutorial' row (menu-app-tutorial) restarts tutorial from Step 1 on demand, identical to auto-triggered flow
Demo account (kauri@intro.demo): tutorial never auto-appears; Profile still shows menu-app-tutorial + menu-edit-profile working normally
Business demo account (business@intro.demo): routes to /business-verified -> (business) layout entirely, never reaches (tabs), no tutorial overlay possible
Regression: current-vibe-pill tap still navigates to /vibe correctly; bottom tab navigation (today/radar/nearby/encounters/profile) all functional
action_items: No functional bugs found. Optional: consider adding a lightweight backend/test-mode hook to auto-verify email + bypass profile-setup/choose-vibe for QA automation of brand-new signups (currently required direct-mongo manipulation to simulate a fully onboarded new user for this test, since there is no test-mode bypass for email verification in server.py -- flagged only for future testability, not a bug).

Not independently tested in this session: the exact register->verify-email(real click)->profile-setup->choose-vibe UI wizard path itself (used direct DB field seeding instead to reach the tabs as a fresh, tutorial_completed=false user) -- the onboarding wizard itself was already covered in prior iterations and was not modified by this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: TutorialContext.tsx / TutorialOverlay.tsx / tutorialRefs.ts are clean, well-scoped, single-purpose files, all well under the 700-line guideline.

persistCompleted() in TutorialContext.tsx correctly swallows PUT failures (best-effort) so a network blip won't crash the app, though it means completion could silently fail to persist in bad network conditions and the tutorial would show again next launch -- acceptable tradeoff given it's just a first-run UX aid, not a data-integrity issue.
Server-side StateUpdate.tutorial_completed and own_user()'s default-True-for-legacy-docs pattern is the correct approach to avoid ever bothering existing users.

TutorialOverlay ring geometry for tab icons uses a static TAB_ORDER array assumption about visual tab order/count -- fine for current People-mode 5-tab layout, but would silently mis-highlight if tab order/count changes for professional mode (not a bug today since tutorial is People-mode only, just a maintenance note).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows passed (8/8 steps, skip, replay, demo/business exclusion, regression)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up ephemeral TEST_ prefixed personal accounts (register + direct mongo field seeding to simulate fully-onboarded new users, since real email verification requires an inbox click with no test-mode bypass). All TEST_ accounts deleted after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New 8-step tutorial feature is fully working end-to-end: auto-show-once for new personal users, Skip/Finish persistence via PUT /api/users/me/state, Profile replay row, and exclusion for demo/business accounts all verified. Testing required localStorage auth_token injection + direct mongo field seeding (email_verified, bio, photos, interests, vibe) to simulate a freshly-onboarded new personal user reaching the tabs, since there's no backend test-mode bypass for real email verification. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter92_tutorial.py for future regression of tutorial_completed defaults/persistence.
